title: Things to Do (for the weekend of October 17th)
description:
Got plans in Los Angeles this weekend? From pollinator workshops and vibrant street festivals to healthcare resources and stargazing, there’s plenty happening around L.A.!

🐝 Protect the Pollinators Workshop
Learn how to create a thriving oasis for birds and pollinators at this free workshop with Green Gardens Group. Discover the role of native plants, what attracts pollinators, and the environmental factors threatening their health. Advance registration required.
📅 Saturday, October 17 | 9–11 AM
📍 Augustus F. Hawkins Nature Park
🔗 GreenGardensGroup.com

🎶 21st Annual Taste of Soul
Celebrate Black culture, community, and creativity with live music, delicious food, local vendors, and family-friendly activities at one of L.A.'s largest free street festivals.
📅 Saturday, October 17 | 10 AM–7 PM
📍 Crenshaw Boulevard, between Obama Boulevard and Stocker Street
🔗 TasteofSoulLA.org

🩺 Covered California Outreach and Enrollment
Meet one-on-one with certified Covered California enrollment counselors to explore healthcare coverage options that fit your needs and budget. Find out whether you qualify for low-cost or no-cost coverage through Medi-Cal.
📅 Saturday, October 17 | 12–2 PM
📍 Baldwin Hills Branch Library
🔗 LAPL.org/events

🔭 Public Star Party
Explore the cosmos at Griffith Observatory's free Public Star Party! Look through dozens of telescopes and learn about the Sun, Moon, planets, and night sky from local astronomy enthusiasts.
📅 Saturday, October 17 | 2–9:45 PM
📍 Griffith Observatory
🔗 GriffithObservatory.org
